body.name: Observable oracle-adaptation Gram tests
body.construction: For each \(x\), let \(a_x^{\mathrm{or}}\) minimize \(\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)^{\prime}\Omega_x\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)\) and let \(d_x^{\mathrm{or}}\) minimize \(\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)^{\prime}\Omega_x\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)\), using the Euclidean minimum-norm minimizer. Define the simultaneous discrepancy as \(\sum_xp_X(x)c(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x^{\mathrm{or}})^{\prime}\Omega_xc(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x^{\mathrm{or}})\), the PT-oracle discrepancy as \(\min_{(d_x)}\sum_xp_X(x)c(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x)^{\prime}\Omega_xc(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x)\), and the SC-oracle discrepancy as \(\min_{(a_x)}\sum_xp_X(x)c(a_x,d_x^{\mathrm{or}})^{\prime}\Omega_xc(a_x,d_x^{\mathrm{or}})\).
